notes.title: Introducing: Intentions
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/32e2b96cc4f434f384eb44a49c0b06badd4c1c0f.png[/img]

[h2]MEADOW INTENTIONS RELEASE[/h2]

Introducing Intentions, a new feature intended both to give guidance to new players, and new things to do for seasoned Meadovians.

[quote] [i]“Meadow is an open-concept experience by nature, allowing the player to shape it any way they want. However, from time to time we were receiving feedback, especially from new players, that sometimes they find themselves looking for guidance and a goal to pursue when they launch the game. To make them feel included, we came up with [b]Intentions[/b]. 

[b]Intentions[/b] are our way to give you a spark of inspiration. A task to follow if you are looking for one, both short and long term – together with other players, or solo. You are rewarded for your efforts and the time you put into them, but the journey itself shall be a reward as well. That is why the tasks are focused on exploration and discovery, which have always been the foundation of the game, along with non-verbal communication. 

We hope that [b]Intentions[/b] will enrich your gameplay and you will enjoy them as much as we enjoyed creating them.”

[b]           Emilia Stoch, a game designer [/b][/i] [/quote]


Check the daily, weekly and monthly intentions in the Journal view. Complete an intention to earn a reward!
[list]
[*] The daily intention will be refreshed at 10:00 am (CET) every day.
[*] The weekly intention will be refreshed at 10:00 am (CET) every Monday.
[*] The monthly intention will be refreshed at 10:00 am (CET) on the 1st of each month.
[/list]
Each intention contains 1~2 tasks. Completing an intention requires completing all of its tasks. Currently, there are 3 types of tasks:

[h3]Collect[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/0f93fc0c9f3bd732e847c19dec228fa17289426b.png[/img]
The collect task requires a certain number of flowers, fungi, puzzle pieces, etc. to be collected within the deadline of the intention.

[h3]Eat[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/a23b4a76b16243fd7ada4576c116295eec807fdd.png[/img]
The eat task requires a certain number of fruits to be eaten within the deadline of the intention.

[h3]Enter[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/26302118/52cd8a6c98a0e69e495e69ba0cbe067d762b267a.png[/img]
The enter task requires entering a certain number of leaf piles, mud puddles, etc. within the deadline of the intention.

[b]NOTE![/b] Repeatedly entering the same area in one session will not increase the count of enter task.


[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the bug that the player could eat fruit while sleeping.[/list]
[h3][b]Other Updates[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Repeatedly entering the same leaf pile/snow pile/lotus leaf in one session will no longer increase the count of the achievement [b]jump into leaf pile/snow pile/lotus leaf[/b]. [/list]

But if you want to really save some money, we recommend the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42828/The_Shelter_Collection/][b]Shelter Collection[/b][/url]. notes.title: World Parrot Day in Meadow
notes.content:
Hello, 

On May 31 bird enthusiasts everywhere celebrate [url=https://nationaltoday.com/world-parrot-day/]World Parrot Day[/url] and obviously we're going to as well! So, between from 12:00 CEST today, running for 24 hours, we will let everyone play as the Eagle with its Scarlet Macaw skin. 

Here's some fun stuff about the Scarlet Macaw:

[i]The scarlet macaw is a gorgeous kind of parrot that you might envision sitting on the shoulder of an archetypal pirate. In the wild, their life span is 40-50 years on average, but they’ve been known to live up to a staggering 90 years in captivity! The scarlet macaw is easily identified by its vibrant red body and the strikingly blue wings and is probably what most of us imagine when we hear the word parrot. And that beak is not a joke, as it can snap a broomstick in half, allegedly. Not putting my finger in there, that’s for sure. Not to worry though, there’s no biting allowed in Meadow.[/i]

See you in the skies!

notes.title: Leopard and Koala Day in Meadow
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, [/h3]

On the 3rd of May we celebrate not one, but[i] two[/i] amazing animals. [b]Both leopards and koalas share this day as their respective "holiday"[/b], which of obviously means that we're making the lynx cub with its leopard skin AND the bear cub with its koala skin available for everyone. This will happen [u]00:01 GMT-9 and run until 23:59[/u] (11:01-10:59 CEST). 

[b]Why the change in timezones?[/b] Well, because our community manager had a moment of confusion regarding what days this is supposed to happen - which resulted in this announcement being late. So, we're fixing the loss of those precious hours on your end by offsetting appropriately. This person has also been sent to LBCAT camp ("Learn Basic Calendar and Time") so that this won't happen again. He reports that he's being fed adequately and that his studies have been "eye opening". 

Here's some tidbits about leopards and koalas respectively: 

[i]Leopards (...) belong to the group of animals we recommend that you keep your distance from. A lot of us know how much it sucks to be clawed by a house cat, so imagine the absolute mayhem a cat ten times bigger can cause. But boy are they beautiful, with their majestic spots. Did you know that the spots of a leopard are called rosettes because they’re similar to roses in shape? Or that they can reach running speeds of up to 58 km/h? Oh, and they can jump up to 6 meters. Yeah, so don’t get on their bad side.

Koalas... they are cool. They sleep 18 hours a day, which we would too if we had the gall. They are very picky eaters; living exclusively off of eucalyptus leaves, despite these leaves being very low on nutrients (hence the long naps) and toxic to most other animals. Also, they’re the national symbol of Australian wildlife. The country known for having the scariest animals in the world uses the Koala as the symbol for their wildlife. Need we say more?
[/i]

Tomorrow we have yet another animal day to celebrate, but that announcement will come later today. Stay tuned!

notes.content:
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tree's don’t have outline and don’t twitch anymore.

If you are still experiencing excessive blur, please also make sure that you are using a proper resolution.

[h3]Motion sickness issue[/h3]
To solve the problem of motion sickness caused by picture movement that doesn't match the body's expectations, we've reduced the default speed of camera rotation.

If you feel uncomfortable while playing, please turn down the camera control speed appropriately and set the camera mode to static, in [u]Settings > Game[/u] page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/0503105499b87b6c2c73b419e7b3e168fcea6150.png[/img]

Additionally, the frame rate and whether V Sync is enabled or not can affect motion sickness to some extent. Please adjust them to a more comfortable value in Settings > Graphics page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/be224f4d1f0506a376cfe5352f4faaea524f526c.png[/img]

If changing settings doesn't help with motion sickness issues, do not hesitate to share your experience, game settings, screenshots, or gameplay recordings and details about the device you’re playing on with us on Discord.

We will continue to try to improve it, in order to bring you a better gaming experience.

[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Close button which can be clicked by mouse is now added for animal editor view and player list.
[*] Emotes selected on the quick selection wheel can are now sent upon releasing the quick selection wheel button.
[/list]

notes.title: National Hedgehog Day in Meadow
notes.content:
[h3]Hello,[/h3]

Thank for joining us for Zebra Day yesterday! But the fun isn't over yet as tomorrow is National Hedgehog Day! The history of this day goes back all the way to Roman tradition, as the little critters were used as pre-TV weather men (no joke). As they were observed to hibernate during winter, the romans would look out for sightings of hedgehogs in February to predict warmer weather being imminent. If none were to be seen, it was taken as a sign of a prolonged winter.

Nowadays we know that these prickly creatures typically hibernate all the way into March, and we have actual human weathermen to pick up their duties. Still, National Hedgehog Day is still recognized as a thing, happening on February 2nd and while they aren't endangered their numbers are in decline because of habitat loss, dwindling food sources and parasites. So watch out for them when you mow your lawn! 

In Meadow we're participating in the celebration of National Hedgehog Day by unlocking the playable Hedgehog and its blue skin for every player from [b]00:01 to 23:59 tomorrow,[/b] central european time. 

Why blue, you ask? You know why.

notes.content:
[h3]Hello, [/h3]

I hope you're doing well and are in good spirits! Today we have a little surprise in clothing form for you because we just released our first Meadow t-shirt. You're probably aware that we launched our merchandise store last week, but you Meadow fans may have noticed that we didn't have a specifically Meadow themed t-shirt in our initial stock. Well, now we do. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/04d7f4fff281e868c646eda74541b3cdf0f38d10.png[/img]

It comes in two playful and carefully selected colours, [url=https://store.mightanddelight.com/autumn-joy-lavender]Lavender[/url] and [url=https://store.mightanddelight.com/autumn-joy-sage]Sage[/url], and like all of our products they're made with the finest organic materials. We're really happy with how it turned out! But we wanted to make it extra special, and we did so by having it come with a download code for two skins: one for the Eagle and one for the Pheasant. These t-shirts are limited edition - [b]only 100 has been made of each[/b], so don't wait too long if you want one! 

[b]Now, let me introduce the Peacock and the Scarlet Macaw! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/944b70e5d6574a86f831b936a772a024432a1c39.jpg[/img]

Did you know that all peacocks are male? It makes sense when you think about it, but we’re so used to talking about peacocks as if they’re a species of bird rather than the males of one. The collective name is peafowl, the females are called peahens and the babies are peachicks. In Meadow, however, you can be a female peacock if you so wish. Who’s going to stop you?

The scarlet macaw is a gorgeous kind of parrot that you might envision sitting on the shoulder of a archetypal pirate. In the wild their life span is 40-50 years on average, but they’ve been known to live up to a staggering 90 years in captivity! The scarlet macaw is easily identified by its vibrant red body and the strikingly blue wings and is probably what most of us imagine when we hear the word parrot. And that beak is no joke, as it can snap a broomstick in half, allegedly. Not putting my finger in there, that’s for sure. Not to worry though, there’s no biting allowed in Meadow.

[b]NOTE:[/b] [i]The Peacock and Scarlet Macaw Skin Pack can be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2615970/Meadow_Peacock_and_Scarlet_Macaw_Skin_Pack/?beta=0]purchased on its own[/url], and is not exclusively tied to the t-shirts.[/i]

[url=store.mightanddelight.com]Click here[/url] to get to the Might and Delight store. Thank you, Meadowers, for your continued support! Talk to you again soon!

[b]Best wishes, 
Oliver and the team at Might and Delight[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26302118/9a7bc44b67f8e3eb4d9db3970e71c00569d8eaf4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello! [/h3]

Another week, another premium skin pack. This time it's the Streaked Tenrec & Leopard Cub Skin Pack.

The lowland streaked tenrec, also known as the Madagascar hedgehog shrew, is as bizarre looking as it is endearing. Its most distinguishing features are the black coat with yellow streaks, its long nose and the black and yellow quills. It’s also the only mammal known to use stridulation, something that’s more common amongst insects and snakes. This means that they rub the tips of their quills together to generate a high frequency noise, thought to be a way for mother and babies to communicate. Unfortunately, they don’t come in blue and they don’t wear running shoes.

The leopard cub doesn’t need an introduction, surely. They’re kittens, but cooler since they have gorgeous spots and grow up to be beautiful and fearsome predators large enough to take you down in single combat. At Might and Delight we’re not afraid to break your heart, though, so here’s a sad fact for you: it’s estimated that less than 40% of leopard cubs survive their first year. Now, you may be curious about why the survival rate is so low, but we didn’t have it in us to research it. It could be leopard cub eating monsters for all we know. You go find out, if you really want that knowledge.

[b]This pack contains two skins, one for the Hedgehog and one for the Lynx Cub.[/b]

[h3]Hello![/h3]

Today we're launching our third set of premium skins for Meadow. Welcome the Lemming Family Skin Pack to the game! 

The lemming is a feisty rodent (the real ones, not the video game ones), about which there are lots of misconceptions. notes.title: Meadow Live Update November 1 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Meadow Classic[/h3]

For anyone who wants to play Meadow as it has been before this update, and any future update we apply, we've created a separate branch of the game that we call Meadow Classic. You can view it as Meadow frozen in time. Players on Classic will inhabit the same space as players on the regular branch, but won't get the benefit of new updates and won't see new skins or be able to engage with any new features. It's for those of you who want Meadow to stay exactly the same.

How to join Meadow Classic: 
[list]
[*] Right-click the game in your Steam library
[*] Go to Properties
[*] Go to Betas
[*] Choose "meadow_classic"
[/list]

[h3]New features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Initial support of HTTPS servers to avoid antiviruses blocking connections. The initial test server for this solution is called “Europe Beta”.
[*] Project is now updated to the newer version of Unity
[*] Sense mode now highlights flowers and puzzle pieces
[*] Analytics are now added to improve the current and future experience for the players
[*] The default setting of the camera for all new players will be the camera following the player; the existing players can pick this setting for camera behavior in the settings
[*] The settings now include the option to set culling to “eyesight” mode, that is supposed to reflect differences between the capabilities of different animals in the real world
[*] The eagle now has a smaller collider to ease the navigation while flying through the forests
[*] Remote config has been implemented to the project; for more information please check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kTHf4rBNx9I&ab_channel=MightandDelight]this video
[/url][*] News pop-up is now connected with the remote config tool and will be displaying news after each update
[*] New lobby screen
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] News popup: if there's no news, the game no longer hangs/crashes at boot
[*] The server ping reports are no longer unreliable, and do not falsely report server status
[*] Reworked network code in an attempt to make connections more reliable.
[*] Changes in network infrastructure
[*] The Den now displays the correct amount of essence on startup
[*] Spawning of collectables in the Jungle is working as intended - the abundance now becomes the new Jungle reality. Fruit and flowers enjoyers - rejoice!
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]

[list]
[*] Some meshes in the tropical region being distorted on some GPUs
[*] Funghi and crystals are not detected in the sense mode
[*] Some of the cloud models being rotated vertically
[*] Some people experience issues with connection and for some it still takes a few attempts
[*] Mac not supported
[/list]

You're very welcome to report bugs and give feedback on your Meadow experience on our [url=https://discord.gg/JAQMkqr2vc]Discord server[/url].

It’s been a good while since we gave you an update on Meadow, and as we approach the anniversary we thought we would touch base and let you know what the future for Meadow looks like - at least in broad terms. 

As many of you know we at Might and Delight have recently released Book of Travels to Early Access and rebuilt our team, and so we’ve also been able to allocate more staff and resources to the further development of Meadow. 

Whilst we aren’t ready to go into detail on exactly what we're working on today, we [i]can [/i]confirm that [b]we do indeed have plans for new features, quality of life improvements, stability updates, downloadable content[/b] and more for Meadow. In the coming weeks we will update and reveal the specific details of these plans and what it means for Meadow and the world of Shelter in general.

The development of these new features has already started, as people may have noticed with our first beta release, but as this grows it will affect the overall production cost of Meadow, and so [b]in the future we will raise the price of the game[/b]. This will also put us in a better position to support Meadow long term. We’re expecting this change will be applied in early November, to coincide with new features being released. 

Exciting times ahead, friends! Again, you’ll hear from us again soon - so stay tuned in the meantime.

notes.title: Anniversary Content Update 2018-10-24
notes.content:
Hello all!

It's been two years since we released Meadow (actually in 2 days, but we're cheating on that). It's been an interesting project to work with, and we've appreciated all your input and enthusiasm along the way. Todays update is a mix of a lot of ideas and input, shaped through an M&D lens.
Regardless if you're an old or new player, we hope that you'll enjoy our second anniversary update.

But without further ado, here is what's new for today:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26302118/d62f405596d1a0dc3570fde58308e9f5aa56495a.png[/img]

[b][u]Other changes[/u][/b]

[*] There is now a way to change the resolution in the Connect screen (if it's far too small or large on your screen). Hold Left Shift and browse through the resolutions with UpArrow/DownArrow.
[*] The Eagle can now have the Home action.
[*] The sound effect when other players pick up items is now a limited effect in the audio menu.
[*] The grove number and server name is now on top of the pause menu.
[*] The block/mute animals menu now only shows the distance of the closest animals.
[*] You can now lock the emote hotbar.
[*] There is now a north facing arrow in the map view.
[*] You can now hold Left Control when scrolling to zoom the camera to change the vertical offset of the camera.
[/list]

[b][u]Bug fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Muted and blocked animals are now saved between sessions.
[*] The bug where an animal would walk a little bit forward after backing and then stopping is now solved.
[*] Various level bugs fixed.
[/list]

[list]
[*] A lot of laggyness that came with the update should now be solved.
[*] The hidden achievement should now trigger as intended.
[*] The amount of animals in the pause view should now be correct.
[*] The waterfall sound where the river enters the sea is now removed.
[*] The new music track now has a delay, and then a percentage chance if it will start playing.

[*] Snow piles should now be easier to see.
[*] The first wolf voice should now be louder.

[*] The new north arrow on the map is now togglable in the Gameplay settings.

[*] The Wolfs collision is now adjusted (should solve issues like difficulties to jump on steep walls etc.)
[*] The Bear cub now have footprints and footstep sounds again.
[*] The Wolf should now not make idle head movements while drinking.
[*] The new areas music should now not be able to be interrupted in the middle.
[*] The randomization of the new areas music should now be more even.
[*] The water should now be affected by fog again.
[*] The correct hedgehog skin should now be displayed in the Puzzle screen.
[*] The idle head movements should not not trigger together with the play action.
[*] The auto-find of resolution when one first starts the game should now be better.
[*] Several issues with particle changes should now be solved (particles should no longer linger, there should now not be autumn leaves in the autumn cave after you respawn there, etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: Content update 2018-07-25
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There has been some discussion on the forum about accessibility and customizations, and this update is mainly dedicated to improving the experience for everyone.
Happy Meadowing!

[b][u]Content additions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new Hedgehog skins
[*] You can now customize which Goat horns that go with which skin
[*] There are now symbols in the den screen to clarify where the animals are placed. This can be turned off in the Gameplay Settings menu.
[*] You can now choose which songs you want in your music mix, and how frequently they appear (in the Audio Settings menu)
[*] There is now a system to prevent sound stacking. In the Audio Settings menu, if you flip to the second page, there is now settings to tweak certain effects (you can turn them off, or have the sounds be unlimited). You can also toggle their visual effects there.
[*] You can now mute and block other players in the Character Options menu.
[*] You can now toggle the space effects in the Gameplay menu.
[*] You can now set the intensity of the tree movement in the Gameplay menu.
[/list]


[b][u]Other changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The day/night transitions are now slower
[*] The Fire 3D emote now spreads light in night time
[*] The mud effect now fades away after a while.
[*] You can now switch between voices in the regular game view. The voice options are toggled with a button under the emote categories (emotes, commands, actions, special).
[/list]

[b][u]Bug fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The space track volume is now controlled by the music volume instead of the sound volume.
[*] The paths in the world that disappeared a few updates ago are now back.
[/list]

[b][u]Hotfixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The voices-button in the interface now gets hidden by the hide-button
[*] You can now stop the sample tracks in the Audio Settings menu
[*] Removed the mud timeout for now (because more people appreciated being mudded until changed, and it's togglabe if you don't want to be mudded by others)
[*] The Eagles emote maps no longer gets reset to exclamation marks when mapped to 3D emotes
[*] The Tree Movement slider should now work
[*] The Other Players list in CharacterOptionsView now doesn't display names if you have Block Names enabled
[*] The Other Players list in CharacterOptionsView should now not stop working after a while
[*] The Other Players list in CharacterOptionsView should now update the list, names, and distances continuously
[*] When you have voices enabled in the interface, hide the interface, and show the map, the voices now also keep hidden
[*] The issue that some 3D emotes (ex. the Counting Flower) stops working for a bit after changing characters should be solved
[*] The Hedgehog no longer gets suspended mid-air when using its play action in the middle of a jump
[/list]

notes.content:
We're happy to release this autumn-themed celebration to Meadows' first birthday! (Technically it's tomorrow, October 26th, but we're doing a little head start since it's a wednesday today.)
Whether you were in the beta group, or just picked this up, we hope you'll enjoy the update. See you all in the Meadow!

[*] New collectable category: Mushrooms
	24 types of mushrooms are now available to find in the Meadow. Divided up in common, rare, and fabled, these fungal treats should light up quite a few strolls in the woods and caves. A task for Doctor Malcom, or will someone else step up?

[*] New pheasant skin
	A new skin based on the winning entry from the pheasant skin art contest, by SeleneTheWerewolf!

[*] New toy: Leaf piles
	Jump around and rejoice in these poofy piles for some autumn feeling.

[*] 9 new achievements
	Related to the Hedgehog, the mushrooms, and the leaf piles.

[*] New language: Ukranian is now available thanks to Mykhailo Radzievskyi!
[/list]


[u][b]Other changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Camera zoom in/out is now available to keybind in the controls menu.
[/list]


[u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Some food not giving essence should be solved.
[*] Food sometimes getting stuck in an animals mouth should be solved.
[*] Badger animation freeze in the drink animation solved.
[*] Some animals sometimes not being clickable in the den should be solved.
[*] The catnip mode getting stuck when sensing again when the effect is going out should be solved.
[*] Invisible buttons in the den reacting (made the mouse over sound) solved.
[*] Many level bugs (weird spawning places, flying grass, etc.) have been solved.
[/list]

[u][b]Hotfixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Hedgehogs no longer get a lighter colour when getting muddy.
[*] The sound when the hedgehog lands from a greater height should now be audible.
[*] The puzzle view not showing the hedgehog image when it's fully unlocked solved.
[*] A few localization errors fixed
[*] Clicking on animals available in the connection screen fixed
[*] Names of animals sometimes changing to gibberish should be solved
[/list]

In a contest of ideas

And takes home the price that is
